title: VDBE final label fixup, reader/write flags, and virtual-table argument sizing

scope.rationale: resolveP2Values is the source builder finalization scan that consumes resolved labels, patches negative jump P2 operands, computes maximum VUpdate/VFilter argument demand, derives read-only/reader flags, and releases Parse label storage. Its reverse scan and generated opcode-property coupling form one atomic unit.
excluded_responsibilities: VDBE MakeReady allocation and execution-state transition
Generated opcode production beyond consumed properties/max-jump ordering

external_source_responsibilities: Generated mkopcodeh opcode ordering, jump properties, and maximum jump opcode
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete active reverse finalization scan, consumed labels, flags, property table and max-vtab-argument output are assigned. MakeReady callers and compiler mask population remain follow-on units.

inputs: INIT-state Vdbe ending in a reverse-reachable OP_Init, Parse resolved-label array, initial max-vtab-argument count, generated opcode properties
outputs: Patched nonnegative jump P2 operands, updated max argument count, readOnly/bIsReader flags, freed aLabel and reset nLabel
contracts.ownership: Parse label storage is connection-owned and freed exactly once after the scan; aLabel becomes null and nLabel becomes zero. Operations remain Vdbe-owned.
contracts.state_and_results: The scan runs backward and stops at OP_Init. Transaction/control opcodes derive reader/write flags. VUpdate uses P2; VFilter uses the immediately preceding Integer P1. Negative jump labels resolve through ADDR and generated jump properties.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the connection mutex. No callback or I/O occurs.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Source requires mallocFailed==0 on entry. All labels must already resolve. Finalized operation bytes and flags remain valid for MakeReady; label owner is retired even when no labels existed.

representation_differences: C generated sqlite3OpcodeProperty[] is the generated Zig properties array indexed by enum(u8).
C goto exits the reverse loop at OP_Init; Zig uses a structured loop break without changing visited operation order.
Vdbe bitfields are exact packed Zig VdbeFlags fields.

oracle.protocol: The shared symbolic builder program emits Init/jump/label/Transaction and VFilter/VUpdate programs, then C and Zig run finalization and compare inspected P2, maximum virtual-table arguments, reader/write flags, nLabel, and aLabel ownership as part of a 366-observation trace.
oracle.normalization: Opcode, P2, maximum arguments, flags, counts and null ownership are exact; allocation addresses are ignored.

assurance.oom: Entry requires no sticky OOM; preceding label growth OOM/continuation is covered by the same 366-observation worker.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or callback; caller mutex remains integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assertions constrain OP_Init placement, VFilter/Integer adjacency, jump labels and targets; symbolic programs exercise each active special case family.
assurance.continuation: Final bytes and metadata are observed after label owner retirement; MakeReady integration remains open.
assurance.performance: Reverse scan, max-jump fast filter, generated property lookup and stop point preserve source order.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic native worker reaches exact operation/Parse/Vdbe owners; production handwritten compiler does not yet call finalization.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Production ownership waits for VDBE create/P4/readiness/deletion and compiler migration.

independent_review.notes: Requires MakeReady/compiler integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Port and integrate VDBE creation, P4 ownership, MakeReady/operation transfer, and deletion.
Switch compiler ownership from handwritten Program to source builder and retire the duplicate.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeaux.c:840-975 was reviewed completely for resolveP2Values preconditions, reverse scan, special opcode cases, label patching, generated-property assertions, label retirement, and outputs
upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeInt.h:490-525 was reviewed for exact readOnly/bIsReader bitfields, btreeMask, counters, zSql, and expmask adjacency

src/core/internal/vdbe_aux.zig resolveP2Values, packed VdbeFlags fields, btreeMask, and generated opcodes.properties are canonical AST-hashed targets
callers: sqlite3VdbeTakeOpArray calls resolveP2Values before transferring aOp and sqlite3VdbeMakeReady calls it before runtime allocation/state transition
Compiler callers populate labels, btreeMask, Transaction/control opcodes, and VUpdate/VFilter argument conventions before finalization
MakeReady/TakeOpArray ownership and runtime execution remain follow-on units
callees: The scan initializes readOnly=true/bIsReader=false and walks backward from the last operation to mandatory Init at index zero
Transaction/AutoCommit/Savepoint and Checkpoint/Vacuum/JournalMode derive reader/write flags; VUpdate P2 and preceding Integer before VFilter derive max virtual-table arguments
Negative P2 on generated jump properties resolves through ADDR/aLabel; generated maximum-jump ordering skips unrelated opcodes
After scan, aLabel is freed non-null, set null, nLabel reset, max args published, and reader/btreeMask invariant asserted
assertions_branches_cleanup: All 38 behavior IDs cover entry/state, reverse loop, every special opcode family, label/property/range invariants, stop label, cleanup, and final invariant
Entry forbids sticky OOM and requires all labels resolved; no allocation, callback, or I/O occurs during scan
Operations remain VDBE-owned while Parse label storage is consumed exactly once even when the label set is empty
Debug-only subroutine validation is excluded and no generated-property behavior beyond consumed flags/order is credited
upstream_tests: Upstream expression/planner/mutation/virtual-table bytecode suites exercise label patching, read-only classification, and argument sizing through prepare
Query-only/read-only, transaction, pragma, vtab, bytecode, and OOM suites observe resulting metadata and preconditions
Project builder differential emits Init/jump/Transaction/VFilter/VUpdate programs and compares targets, max args, flags, label retirement, and generated-property decisions
